quest.title: Something's Wrong With the Water
quest.description: Freminet seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been such a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Freminet? Why are you wearing your diving helmet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you just come out of the water?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Mmhmm... Things down there have been a bit hectic lately.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: There are so many more divers right now, all in a frenzy to salvage sunken cargo. All I can do is try my best to lend a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: The sooner we finish cleaning up, the sooner these extra divers can go back to their day jobs, and the sooner the seas can go back to their usual peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I see... It must be really hard for you to adapt to all the commotion, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Thanks for your concern, Paimon. It's not all that bad, though. I've actually made a few extra finds — things like unclaimed jewelry and antiques...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: "Father" said that if I salvage any pretty or valuable things, I should bring them here. She said you'd be able to find a use for them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Arlecchino sure is thoughtful! If you've got any pretty-looking ornaments that nobody wants anymore, we could use them to decorate the aquarium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or even better, why don't we go salvaging with you?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Are you sure? I wouldn't want to waste your precious time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry about that! You already said we can keep any ownerless goodies you find.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how could we let you do all the work yourself? Taking the fruits of someone else's labor while we sit here twiddling our thumbs doesn't sit well with Paimon!

choices.text: Besides, finding things yourself is half the fun!

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: In that case... I'll share everything the other divers have told me. Hopefully, that'll help narrow down your search...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: If you find anything that takes your fancy, feel free to make good use of it... However, some things are wanted by their owners, so if you find one of those, you'll need to return it.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Please stay safe, and don't stray into unfamiliar waters. If you run into danger, make sure to surface as quickly as it's safe to do so.

choices.text: We like hunting for underwater treasure, too!
